description: Users report being unable to sign in because their password is rejected or account access is blocked.
Users object to basic playback controls and features being restricted to Premium, including selecting songs, skipping, and seeking within tracks.
Examples report missing songs, limited gospel music, and lyrics that are absent or fail to appear, as well as vague praise and dissatisfaction with recommendations.
A user reports that offline listening is not working.
Reviews express general dissatisfaction, disappointment with updates, unspecified restrictions, or unrelated boycott sentiment without a consistent, specific product problem.
Examples cover playback interruptions, loading and launch failures, control behavior, assistant playback, and background downloads, alongside a vague inability-to-play complaint.
The reviewer objects to Spotify's support of LGBTQ+ people, without identifying a product support problem.
Examples mention frequent or intrusive ads, limited song selection controls for non-subscribers, and difficulty navigating directly to a song.
